questions.q: What kind of animal is Miyamoto Usagi?
questions.why: Usagi is an anthropomorphic rabbit who walks the land as a masterless swordsman.
Stan Sakai created Usagi and has written and drawn his adventures for decades.
Usagi is a masterless samurai wandering Japan on a warrior's pilgrimage.
Sakai modeled his wandering rabbit samurai on the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi.

questions.q: What is the name of Usagi's son?
questions.why: Jotaro is Usagi's son, who appears in later stories of the series.

questions.q: In which 1984 comic did Usagi first appear?
questions.why: The rabbit samurai debuted in 1984 in the second issue of Albedo Anthropomorphics.

questions.q: Which Netflix series from 2022 follows a descendant of Miyamoto Usagi?
options: The Usagi Ronin Chronicles of Old Edo
questions.why: Samurai Rabbit: The Usagi Chronicles (Netflix, 2022) centres on his descendant Yuichi, with Miyamoto Usagi in a smaller role.

questions.q: Which rival noble gave Usagi the scar over his left eye?
questions.why: The scheming Lord Hikiji left Usagi with an arched scar over his left eye.

questions.q: Who voiced Usagi in the 1987 TMNT cartoon?
questions.why: Townsend Coleman voiced Usagi in the 1987 TMNT cartoon, where he appeared in two episodes.

questions.q: The creator first imagined Usagi after doodling a bunny whose ears were tied up like what?
questions.why: Sakai's doodle of a long-eared animal with its ears bound like a topknot led to the character.
